issues.on_page: Public Works (heading; Personnel services 173,692 ... Capital outlay 27,194, total public works 517,071)
issues.issue: The General Fund budget schedule prints these five lines (detail[14]-detail[18]) under 'Public Works', but the governmental funds statement (p4) shows the General Fund's 517,071 as Public Health and Welfare. The extractor followed the statement, which keeps the detail tied to the statement functions. This is defensible, but the report contradicts itself, and the user sees only the category, not the heading. No report_discrepancies entry records the mismatch.
